target_customer: Brands and individuals that need product images and short-form promotional videos
problem: Producing product images and short promotional videos is slow and costly.
business_model: B2B SaaS using AI to generate images and video

founders.name: Soumil Singh
education: Harvard (per nzbusiness and NZ Herald search snippets, not opened)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no education for him.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating consistent product imagery and short video with AI was hard for a small team in 2020 and 2021, before generative image and video models were widely available.

defensibility.rationale: Generative tools commoditized quickly, and no proprietary data or distribution was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The competitor search returned only 2026 vendor comparisons, so no dated incumbent response is established.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand was found. The company positioned itself on cutting content production cost 10x.

branding.domain_note: unfaze.ai is the listed site and is now a parked Hostinger domain.
branding.community_and_virality: Founder featured in New Zealand press (NZ Herald, RNZ, NZ Business) as a young Harvard graduate.

brand_strength.rationale: Press focused on the founder story in New Zealand, with no evidence of community, merch or customer facing brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Unfaze AI entered YC Summer 2020, was written up in New Zealand press for AI video creation and is marked inactive by YC with its domain now parked. No shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: Both rounds rest on a single database or outlet each. CB Insights (page slug latent, possibly mixed data) reports a 0.5M convertible note dated 1 Jan 2020, before the batch, with Y Combinator and Citta Capital; the date is likely a placeholder. NZ Herald headline and snippet report a 3.4M US dollar round (5.9M NZD) with YC participating, undated; the article could not be opened because the safety check was rate limited, so details are unverified. The YC launched_at field in the roster is Aug 2021, after the batch. Competitor search found only 2026 vendor lists, so the list is empty. Founded 2020 per YC.
